About Me

A nurse who loves to write.

I have loved writing for as long as I can remember. As I grew and found myself in the medical field, I began to see an opportunity to combine that love for writing with my nursing knowledge to create health and medical content.

Working in the hospital has exposed me to different health conditions and complications, and it has made me realize how important health awareness can be. I have often had conversations with patients about their health, why certain health problems occur, and what could potentially be done to prevent complications.

Those experiences made me realize that health education should not only happen when someone is already in the hospital.

This is one of the reasons I became interested in medical writing. I want to create health content that goes beyond simply giving people information. I want my writing to help people understand their health, recognize possible risks, and take practical steps to protect themselves and their families.

As a Registered Nurse and emerging Medical Writer, I am particularly interested in health education, public health communication, patient education, healthy lifestyle practices and accessible health information.
